about: Per-locale keys whose value was confirmed by a translator although it equals the English text (single words only, e.g. Filipino "Username", German "Layout") or the old label's translation. Written by scripts/i18n/sync.php (--accept-english, reviewed and machine translations); read by scripts/i18n_check.php (accepted English is not counted as translated) and the todo lists. Names that stay English in every locale belong in keep_english.json.
